title: PF: wage ceiling and contribution calculation
excerpt: The EPF statutory wage ceiling is INR 15,000 per month. PF is computed at 12% of basic+DA up to the ceiling. Employees drawing more than INR 15,000 may contribute on actual wage only through a joint option.

title: PF: employees above the wage ceiling (voluntary and restricted contribution)
excerpt: For employees above INR 15,000 wage, employer contribution is restricted to the ceiling unless the joint option is exercised.
